contract.minimum_training_note: New experiment: nine-month minimum replaces legacy 365-day guard. First matched fold has about 328 usable days after warm-up.
contract.date_endpoints: All end dates exclusive. Date ranges are delivery labels; each used outcome must additionally be available strictly before its fit/calibration origin.
contract.point_refit_policy: calendar-month origin changes; first origin always fits
contract.failed_fit_policy: Record failure; use declared fallback until next scheduled parameter fit. No hidden retry or replacement architecture.

compact.description: Executed bounded CPU research search: two configurations per family, all four quarterly validation folds and all daily origins; neural early-stop training capped. This is not an exhaustive architecture search.

extended.description: Larger development-only searches. Requires a NEW run; never tune from the prior test results.

limitations: Hourly interval-start and aggregation conventions are assumptions, not verified source lineage.
Original demand, RTE and weather forecast vintages are absent; no operational superiority claim.
Target-day recorded weather excluded from model inputs; realized cold conditions used only for diagnosis.
Previously exposed historical test cannot be an untouched confirmation set.
National consumption is a portfolio proxy; no euro savings without prices and decision policy.
Split-conformal fixed-model comparator separate from monthly-refitted adaptive policies; time-series exchangeability not established.

extension_spec.features: Original national/regional feature groups plus rte_at_origin_mw and rte_bias_recent_mw
extension_spec.residual_target: actual_mw minus rte_at_origin_mw; add the predicted correction to RTE
extension_spec.search: Same two fast configurations per family as the independent experiment; all four chronological 2024 folds; monthly parameter fits; no random split
extension_spec.selection: Select each variant's configuration using pooled 2024 MAE with raw forecast availability >= 0.99; freeze best assisted variant and best complete policy across the 16 assisted and 27 original policies before new calibration/test replay
extension_spec.cold_guardrail: Report realized-temperature<5 C delivery hours18/19/20 separately; require >=60 hours and20 days to interpret the upper-tail diagnostic. No realized future weather enters predictors. Overall MAE improvement does not establish adequate cold-evening protection.
extension_spec.point_fallback: Require target-interval RTE for assisted raw predictions; if unavailable/invalid/failed, fall back to RTE, then weekly persistence, comparable-day mean, latest observation; report all availability/fallbacks
extension_spec.uncertainty: All policies: fixed empirical distribution of past out-of-sample calibration residuals. Quantile LightGBM: native q05/q50/q95. Best development-selected assisted variant: separate single-fit split-conformal comparator; no exchangeability or conditional guarantees
extension_spec.interval_policy_selection: No interval method selected from the historical test; all methods reported with method-specific labels and availability

critical_risk_scenarios.interpretation: Dimensionless weights times MW error; not euros, realized financial savings or optimal procurement

extension_spec.scope: Research extension in existing notebooks07/08. Neural and univariate statistical models are not silently given unsupported exogenous inputs. No production implementation.
